note: Values the TDH reference pages (How sure and the shelf) print from 6529's design record and 6529.io's own records, each with its source and commit. History does not change; a value that can change is read from the feed, the manifest or the record instead. __tests__/explained/referenceFacts.test.ts checks each value against the source that ships with the site, where one does. No person is named.
